title: Title and tabs jump when you switch tabs, because each tab puts different buttons next to the title
what_happens: Overview has Copy join link + archive beside the title, Synthesis has (i) + Rebuild + Find sources, Logs has none. The title column width changes, so the topic re-wraps and the tab row moves up or down (e.g. 'daily-life-together': tabs at y≈244 on Overview, y≈216 on Synthesis and Logs).
who_hurts: Admins moving between the three tabs see the header shift each time, and the tab they want to click moves.
suggested_fix: Keep the session header fixed (title + Copy link + archive on every tab) and put each tab's own actions (Rebuild, Find sources, Filter) at the right end of the tab row or the first row under it. session-header.tsx:52-61.
rule: established pattern: the admin bar keeps its tabs fixed and puts the page button at the right of the same row (admin-nav.tsx)
